The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough for one of us to survive immediately. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you rather than defecting quietly. If you also take, the split is random. I'm open to hearing a better idea.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. If the episode continues and I can help you reach 4, I will operate with you, and I'm willing to give cells back if that makes a real difference for you.
I have my 4. I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can build up for you, and I won't take anything more. Take whenever the reserve reaches 4.
